transcript.text: These are photos of my café—the storefront pic, the latte pic, and the pastries pic—and I’d like you to make something cosy, warm and inviting with all three. Please use gentle movement, with whatever transitions you think work, and soft upbeat music with no talking. For the English text, put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.
